subject.title: perf(agents): reuse media tool availability during tool prep

question: Should OpenClaw make the shared optional-media plan the canonical registration gate for image and generation tools, accepting that future factory availability changes must update the plan and its equivalence coverage?
rationale: The optimization is technically bounded and proof-positive, but it changes the ownership of registration eligibility across provider/auth-sensitive tools; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want that shared contract to be permanent.

options.title: Adopt the shared planning contract
options.body: Merge after the responsible reviewer confirms that plan and factory availability must evolve together, preserving the existing direct factory and execution-time safeguards.

options.title: Keep per-factory registration checks
options.body: Pause or close this approach if maintainers prefer independent factory predicates over the measured preparation-time reduction.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared planning contract
recommendation.body: Merge after the responsible reviewer confirms that plan and factory availability must evolve together, preserving the existing direct factory and execution-time safeguards.
